vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Whoa! What was that big boom? What is thunder?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! Two clouds bumping into each other! Bonk!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: No, no! A giant playing a big drum in the sky!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good guesses! But clouds are soft, like fog. They can't go bonk.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Thunder is the sound that lightning makes!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Thunder is the sound of lightning!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And we are inside, safe and cozy.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: That's right. When thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: But how does lightning make a sound?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Lightning is super, super hot. Hotter than the outside of the Sun!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: It heats the air so fast that the air jumps out of the way. Whoosh!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And when the air jumps, it makes a giant BOOM. That's thunder!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Like when a balloon pops?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! A bit like that. Bobo, can you show us?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Okay! Here is my balloon. One, two, three... squeeze!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: POP!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The air rushed out, and went pop! A tiny thunder!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Thunder is a giant pop of air, all along the lightning!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: How does the boom get to my ears?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Every sound is the air shaking. The shake travels to your ears!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's see! Clap your hands with me. Clap!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Your clap shook the air, and the shake went into your ears.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Look at my drum! I put some rice on top. Tap, tap!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The rice is jumping! The drum is shaking the air!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Put your hand on your neck, and say aaah!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Aaaaah!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: It tickles! Your voice is shaking too!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Thunder can sound two ways. Listen!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When the lightning is close, the thunder goes CRACK!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When the lightning is far away, the thunder goes rumble, rumble, rumble.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Lightning is very long. Its sound comes from near and far, so it arrives a little at a time.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Like a long train going by! Rumble, rumble!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: This lightning is far away, over the hills. Crack, or rumble?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Rumble, rumble! It's far away!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And this lightning is close! Crack, or rumble?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Crack! It's close!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Thunder is so loud. I'm a little bit scared.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: That's okay, Bobo. Thunder is only a sound. It can't hurt you.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: When thunder is scary, you can hug a teddy...

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: ...cover your ears, or sing a song with a friend!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I feel better now. Thank you, friends!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Want to make a tiny thunder? Ask a grown-up to help!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Blow air into a paper bag. Twist the top.

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Then clap it with your hands. POP! A tiny thunder!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Here's a wow fact. You can hear thunder from very far away!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: If you can hear thunder, lightning is close enough to be careful. Go inside!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: And every lightning makes thunder, even when it's too far to hear!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Quiz time!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What makes thunder? Clouds bumping, or lightning?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The drum giant!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ha ha! No, Bobo. Lightning makes thunder!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Thunder is roaring outside. Do we play in the park, or go inside?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Go inside! When thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Can thunder hurt you?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: No! Thunder is only a sound!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What is thunder?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The sound of lightning!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What did Bobo's balloon do?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: POP! Like a tiny thunder!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What made the rice jump?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The drum shook the air!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Is close thunder a crack, or a rumble?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A crack!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And when thunder roars...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Go indoors!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's say the thunder rhyme!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Lightning flashes, the air goes boom!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Crack is near, and rumble is far!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: When thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Your turn! When thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look! The storm is over. Goodnight, thunder!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bye bye, friends!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
